title: Widget design is good, could be better
text: I was seeking a new app to replace my old star app to present clean planet information in the widget and this is probably the best option for that need. Major complaints: we all know that Mars is red, Jupiter orange, etc, but make them represented by different and clear contrasting colors on the line graph… yes, Venus isn’t green, but if it were, I could actually see which line it is vs. orange and slightly brighter orange… Also should have the option include Saturn or anything else in the lines (ISS or other planets). The time x-axis displays every 3 vertical lines but also showed 11PM on one line. Should be fixed at the obvious 12AM and then show +/- 3 hours. It sometimes says 12AM but I’ve seen it show other hours too. It seems like it shifts the time axis to be in the middle based on the current hour. It should bias the current time to the left somewhat because there is no immediate gain in knowing what planets were visible hours ago at this point. If I wanted a deeper dive, I’d tap and begin to search. I want a future forecast at a glance. As for the rest of the app, it’s alright, but have seen better elsewhere.
